description: The bar chart illustrates the Recall@10 values for different categories. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled with "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking", in that order. The vertical axis is labeled with values ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The bars represent the Recall@10 values for each category, with the "- critiquing" bar colored orange and the other two bars colored blue. The approximate Recall@10 values are 0.34 for "- critiquing", 0.29 for "- scoring", and 0.22 for "- ranking". The bars are not grouped or stacked, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar. The chart does not display any additional annotations or labels beyond the axis labels and category names.
